name: dock
title: Dock
description: An implementation of the MacOS dock using React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.
usage:
import { House, Search, Settings } from "lucide-react"

import { Dock, DockIcon } from "@/components/ui/dock"

export function AppDock() {
  return (
    <Dock>
      <DockIcon>
        <House className="size-5" />
      </DockIcon>
      <DockIcon>
        <Settings className="size-5" />
      </DockIcon>
      <DockIcon>
        <Search className="size-5" />
      </DockIcon>
    </Dock>
  )
}

examples.title: Navigation dock

examples.name: dock-direction
examples.title: Custom direction
examples.description: `direction` aligns the icons to the top, middle or bottom of the dock as they grow.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the dock. Other props are passed to the underlying `motion.div`.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Resting size of every icon in pixels.

props.name: iconMagnification
props.description: Size an icon grows to when the pointer is right over it.

props.name: iconDistance
props.description: Distance in pixels from the pointer within which icons grow.

props.name: direction
props.description: Vertical alignment of the icons inside the dock.

props.name: children
props.description: `DockIcon`s, plus anything else (e.g. a separator), rendered in order.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the icon bubble. Other props are passed to the underlying `motion.div`.

props.name: size
props.description: Resting size in pixels. Overrides the dock's `iconSize` for this icon.

props.name: magnification
props.description: Size when the pointer is right over the icon.

props.name: distance
props.description: Distance in pixels within which the icon grows.

props.name: disableMagnification
props.description: Turn magnification off for this icon.

props.name: mouseX
props.description: Pointer X position to react to. Provided automatically inside a `Dock`; pass one to use an icon on its own.
